mapper.sql: select file_id, assessment_id, visitor_id, file_kind, file_ext, file_size, original_name, storage_path, consent_id, consent_time, parse_status, claim_token, text_source, text_chars, cast(parsed as text) as parsed, fail_reason, ai_status, call_id, error_msg, started_time, finished_time, purge_time, purged_time, del_flag, create_time, update_time from abr_assessment_file
mapper.select: where assessment_id = #{assessmentId} and del_flag = '0' order by create_time, file_id
select count(*) from abr_assessment_file where assessment_id = #{assessmentId}
mapper.insert: insert into abr_assessment_file (assessment_id, visitor_id, file_kind, file_ext, file_size, original_name, storage_path, consent_id, consent_time, parse_status, claim_token, started_time, purge_time, del_flag, create_time, update_time) values (#{assessmentId}, #{visitorId}, #{fileKind}, #{fileExt}, #{fileSize}, #{originalName}, #{storagePath}, #{consentId}, #{consentTime}, 'running', #{claimToken}, now(), #{purgeTime}, '0', now(), now())
mapper.update: update abr_assessment_file set del_flag = '2', original_name = null, storage_path = null, purged_time = coalesce(purged_time, now()), update_time = now() where file_id = #{fileId} and del_flag = '0'

update abr_assessment_file set parse_status = #{parseStatus}, text_source = #{textSource}, text_chars = #{textChars}, parsed = cast(#{parsed} as jsonb), fail_reason = #{failReason}, ai_status = #{aiStatus}, call_id = #{callId}, error_msg = #{errorMsg}, finished_time = now(), update_time = now() where file_id = #{fileId} and claim_token = #{claimToken} and parse_status = 'running'

update abr_assessment_file set parse_status = 'failed', fail_reason = 'timeout', error_msg = '识别超时', finished_time = now(), update_time = now() where assessment_id = #{assessmentId} and del_flag = '0' and parse_status = 'running' and started_time < now() - cast(#{staleSeconds} as integer) * interval '1 second'
update abr_assessment_file set original_name = null, storage_path = null, purged_time = now(), update_time = now() where file_id = #{fileId} and purged_time is null
